title: A-Level Biology (9700) Max pack
blurb: Mark-scheme language for biology — precise terms, structured explanations, and data-response habits.
examinerDigest: Use the exact biological term the scheme expects; near-synonyms often miss the mark.
Structure long answers as discrete mark-worthy points — examiners tick statements, not prose.
In data questions, quote the figure/table reference and compare values explicitly.
Link cause → mechanism → effect when the command word is explain.
